_meta.name: English
banner.power.title: Disturbed power supply
banner.power.body: the sensor detected noise on its power supply at startup. Detections may be less reliable.
chart.tip: Tip: drag a threshold line up or down to adjust it right on the chart.
params.title: Sensor parameters
params.dragHint: Drag them on the chart, or
table.title: Thresholds per gate
table.hint: Values in dB, 0 to 95, to the hundredth.
calib.title: Auto calibration
calib.hint: Empty the room, then let the sensor measure the background noise to compute suitable thresholds.
calib.autoGainHint: Useful if the sensor saturates once mounted in an enclosure.
calib.resultBody: Thresholds were generated and applied. Disturbances were seen on {count} gates: a moving object (fan, curtain) may be the cause.
errors.permissionDenied: Permission denied on {path}. On Linux, add yourself to the dialout group: sudo usermod -aG dialout $USER, then log out and back in.
errors.notFound: Port {path} not found. Check that the sensor is plugged in.
errors.inUse: {path} is in use by another program (serial monitor, Arduino IDE, ModemManager…). Close it and try again.
errors.notLd2402: No LD2402 answered on {path}. Check the wiring (TX↔RX) and the power supply.
errors.timeout: The sensor did not answer in time (command {word}).
errors.unsupported: {feature} is not supported by this firmware (requires {required}).
errors.busy: The sensor is busy with another operation.
errors.forbidden: Blocked a command outside the LD2402 protocol ({word}). Nothing was sent.
errors.backupFailed: Could not save a backup of the current settings ({message}). Nothing was written to the sensor.
errors.config.notAConfig: This file is not an LD2402 configuration.
params.imported: Configuration imported. Click Write to apply it.
params.confirmDiscard: You have changes that were not written to the sensor. Discard them?
params.confirmReload: Re-reading will discard your unwritten changes. Continue?
params.writtenRereadFailed: Settings written, but re-reading them failed.
calib.connectFirst: Connect a sensor first to run the calibration.
calib.measuring: Measuring… stay out of the detection area.
calib.noInterferenceBody: Thresholds were generated and applied. No disturbance was seen on any gate.
calib.timeout: The calibration did not finish: the sensor stopped responding.
autogain.timeout: The gain adjustment did not finish in time.
firmware.title: Firmware
firmware.keepPowered: Do not unplug the sensor during an update.
firmware.unavailable: Firmware update is not available yet: Hi-Link has not published the update protocol.
firmware.olderHint: On older firmware, the matching button is greyed out with an explanation.
